bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PROJECT=TGtumbler\nACTION=GSERVER_TGTUMBLER_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT_READ_ONLY\n'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
home=pathlib.Path.home()
ws=home/'workspace/G-ACE.code-workspace'
root=home/'Project'
gs=root/'Gserver/repository'
print('WSL_USER_HOME_CHECK=',str(home)=='/home/gace')
print('WORKSPACE_EXISTS=',ws.is_file())
if ws.is_file():
 try:
  data=json.loads(ws.read_text())
  print('WORKSPACE_ROOTS=',','.join(sorted(str(x.get('name','')) for x in data.get('folders',[]))))
  print('WORKSPACE_PROJECT_PATH_MATCH=',any(x.get('name')=='projects' and x.get('path')==str(root) for x in data.get('folders',[])))
 except (ValueError,OSError):
  print('WORKSPACE_JSON_INVALID=YES')
print('PROJECTS_ROOT_EXISTS=',root.is_dir())
for name in ['TGtumbler','GateApp-Bot','Gserver','TGbot_grp_system','_TelegramGroup','create-videobot','tumblr-integration']:
 p=root/name
 print('EXISTING_'+name.replace('-','_').upper()+'=', 'SYMLINK' if p.is_symlink() else 'DIR' if p.is_dir() else 'OTHER' if p.exists() else 'ABSENT')
print('GSERVER_REGISTERED_ROOT_EXISTS=',gs.is_dir())
if gs.is_dir():
 for arg in (['rev-parse','HEAD'],['branch','--show-current'],['status','--porcelain']):
  q=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(gs),*arg],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
  if arg[0]=='status':
   print('GSERVER_DIRTY_ENTRY_COUNT=',len(q.stdout.splitlines()) if q.returncode==0 else 'ERROR')
  else:
   print('GSERVER_'+('HEAD' if arg[0]=='rev-parse' else 'BRANCH')+'=',q.stdout.strip() if q.returncode==0 else 'ERROR')
q=subprocess.run(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}}'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
print('DOCKER_LIST_STATUS=', 'PASS' if q.returncode==0 else 'UNAVAILABLE')
if q.returncode==0:
 names=q.stdout.splitlines()
 print('RUNNING_CONTAINER_COUNT=',len(names))
 for key in ['gserver','gaybbs','tgtumbler','telegram','videobot','tumblr']:
  print('CONTAINERS_MATCH_'+key.upper()+'=',sum(key in n.lower() for n in names))
print('MUTATIONS=NONE')
PY
